info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Lincoln Williams (BK)
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-25-2026 at 07:41 PM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Lincoln Williams, a 76-year-old Black Male, last seen near Chestnut Street and Sutter Avenue in Brooklyn at approximately 9:30 AM on 10-24-2026. Lincoln has Alzheimer's, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: Bald. Last seen wearing a green Columbia jacket, black pants, black and gray baseball hat, and eyeglasses.
If you see Lincoln, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Lincoln is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sJ1BuA
